{"id": "aaea92dc-a5f6-416e-bc0b-bc833ff60e7d", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "On a **STANDARD** MediaLive channel, `PipelinesLocked = 0` means **at least one pair of eligible pipelines is not synchronized** — i.e., the two pipelines have lost sync with each other. (A value of `1` means all eligible pipeline pairs are synchronized.)

A few important caveats on when this applies:
- The metric only matters for **STANDARD channels configured for standard pipeline locking** (or epoch locking), and for single-pipeline channels in certain configurations.
- If pipeline locking doesn't apply to your setup, the metric is always reported as `0` by default — so a `0` isn't automatically an alarm signal unless locking is actually in effect for that channel.
- No data points means the channel isn't running.

**Which output group types it applies to:** The metric only applies to output types that support pipeline locking in the first place — if an output group type doesn't support it, the metric won't be meaningful for that output (it'll just report 0 regardless of actual sync state). The documentation I found doesn't enumerate the specific supported output group types by name, so I'd want to verify that list directly against the MediaLive output group docs if you need the exact set.

Want me to look up which specific output group types (e.g., UDP, RTMP, MediaPackage, HLS) support pipeline locking?", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
